subject: Proposed City Charter Amendments
overview: The City Council advanced three proposed charter amendments intended for the November ballot, covering council legal staff, budget authority, and mayoral appointments. The council also approved extended hours for Oasis Restaurant, discussed maintenance and access issues on private ways, and approved an updated outdoor dining ordinance.

items.title: Charter Amendment: Council Staff and Legal Services
items.summary: Approved proposed charter amendment 23-097 pending the six-day comment period, authorizing the council to secure legal and research services.

items.title: Charter Amendment: Municipal Budget Creation and Approval
items.summary: Approved proposed charter amendment 23-098 pending the six-day comment period, modifying the municipal budget process to grant the council authority to reallocate funds between line items.

items.title: Charter Amendment: Mayoral Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved proposed charter amendment 23-099 pending the six-day comment period, making mayoral appointments to municipal boards, committees, and commissions subject to council confirmation.

items.title: Special Permit: Oasis Restaurant Extended Hours
items.summary: Approved an amended special permit allowing Oasis Restaurant to operate until midnight on Wednesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays, alongside a related request for community development to coordinate parking signage with neighboring businesses.

items.title: Common Victualler License: Subway
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license transfer for Med Sub LLC operating as Subway at 4110 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: Resolution: Municipal Compensation Advisory Board
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules to consider establishing an advisory board to regularly study municipal compensation.

items.title: Resolution: Safety and Maintenance of Private Ways
items.summary: Voted to convene a Committee of the Whole with the city engineer and residents to discuss maintenance policies, infrastructure damage, and safety on private ways.

items.title: Resolution: School Spending Information Request
items.summary: Approved a request directing the administration to furnish detailed financial information regarding several school department expenditures ahead of upcoming budget discussions.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Amendments June 2023
items.summary: Referred proposed amendments to the Medford Zoning Ordinance to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Donation Acceptances
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of donations totaling $850 from Boston Proud Corp and Instigators LLC, with a request for written explanation regarding the pride donation.

items.title: Elections Office Updates and Early Voting Schedule
items.summary: Received and placed on file communications regarding municipal election open seats and proposed early voting schedules for September and November, while councilors debated the lack of weekend voting hours and voter census inactivation rules.

items.title: Communication: Firefighters Union Letter
items.summary: Approved placing into the official record a letter from Medford Firefighters Local 1032 regarding the status of contract negotiations and staffing cuts.

items.title: Public Participation: Medford Charter Study Committee
items.summary: Charter Study Committee Chair Milva McDonald invited the public and council to an informational listening session on the comprehensive city charter review.

items.title: Outdoor Dining Ordinance
items.summary: Removed paper 22-514 from the table and approved the outdoor dining ordinance on its third reading.
